summary: Kopin Corp filed an 8-K reporting a Joint Development and License Agreement with Fabric AI, Inc. to collaborate on GPU-to-GPU connectivity technology. Fabric AI will pay up to $15M in development funds, starting with a $5M purchase order within 10 business days, with at least $5M held in a segregated account. After a successful prototype demo, the parties will negotiate a production plan involving an additional $15M–$25M payment. This is a product-development agreement, not a special situation transaction. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or deal mechanics typical of M&A or restructuring are present.
